why: B4 follow-up. 彼女は天使のようにやさしい was released from gram:gp-83 (まい) as のように contamination. It is the simile のように, sense (1) of this record's own explanation ('Comparação ou exemplo: ように … 鳥のように飛ぶ'). Chosen over gp-154/gp-77, which carry the same 〜のように but are a same-level duplicate pair awaiting an owner merge.
B4 follow-up. 雪のように白い花が咲いた is the same simile のように released from gram:gp-83. Same destination as the other three のように carriers so the sense sits in one place.

X-11 follow-up. 今日は晴れて暖かい was released from gram:te-de precisely because 晴れて is the VERB て-form, which te-de's formation rules out. gram:gp-26 is the record for the verb て-form as a connective (label 'forma て (conectiva)'), and its variant 1 is verb > to-te-form.

X-6 follow-up. 雨でも行きます is the concessive 'even if it rains'. gram:temo's own formation names this exact shape: 'Adjetivo-な e substantivo: 〜でも (静かでも, 雨でも)'. It is not the additive も of gram:mo nor the conjunction/suggestion でも of gram:demo.
X-10, the destination the report named. 今、勉強してるところだよ is 〜ているところ (してる is the colloquial contraction of している), the neighbouring record gram:gp-72's own formation distinguishes it from 〜るところだ.
X-10, named destination. 夕食を待っているところだ is 〜ているところ.
X-10, named destination. 上着を今着ているところだ is 〜ているところ.

F-14 follow-up. これが自動化されたらどんなにいいか has no こと, so it never belonged on どんなに〜ことか; what it does carry is the たら conditional (自動化されたら + resulting clause), which is exactly gram:tara's 'condição primeiro, resultado depois'. The final か here is exclamatory, not the embedded question of gram:gp-135.

F5 follow-up. 日本へ行けたらいいのに was released from gram:n3-ba-noni because it is built on たら, not ば. gram:tara is the record for たら. Not filed under gram:noni, whose sense is the concessive 'embora / apesar de', which this regret のに is not.
F-20 follow-up. 万一病気になったらどうする？ is a real question, not the fixed suggestion 〜たらどう？, but it is a textbook たら conditional (condition first, consequence second).
F-16, the destination the report named. あなたなら、どうする？ is the generic なら conditional reacting to a theme, which is gram:nara's whole content; it has no もしも.
F-16, named destination. あなたなら、これをどう考えますか。 — generic なら.
F-16, named destination. あなたなら、どうしますか？ — generic なら.
F-16, named destination. あなたなら良い先生になるでしょう。 — generic なら.

F-14 follow-up. どんなに愛してるか、分かってる？ is a genuine embedded question, which is why it contradicted どんなに〜ことか. gram:gp-135 is the record for exactly that: '[oração na forma simples] + か + verbo de conhecimento (分かる, 知る, 聞く)'.

X-7 follow-up. 「花が咲いているか」と聞いた was released from gram:to-kiita because 聞く here is 'ask', the sense that record excludes. Asking is one of gp-135's own matrix verbs, and the embedded か question is the construction on display.
X-7 follow-up. 駅がどこにあるかと聞いた is the embedded interrogative か before 聞く — gp-135's formation names 聞く as a matrix verb.
X-7 follow-up. 外国へ行きたいかどうかと聞いた carries かどうか whole, so the more specific record wins over gp-135.
F5 follow-up. やることがあるんだ is the ordinary noun こと + がある, which is why it left gram:koto-ga-aru. gram:gp-12 is がある for inanimate/abstract subjects, and its nuance already covers this ('今日テストがある').

F-15 follow-up. 人生には目に見える以上のものがある uses 見える literally, so it left gram:ni-mieru. What it does instantiate is 〜がある with an inanimate head (ものがある). Not filed under gram:gp-92, whose 以上 is the numeric 'X ou mais'.
F-15 follow-up. 動物はでたらめに動くように見える is clause + ように, not the [substantivo/な-adj]に見える formation of gram:ni-mieru. The ように is the manner/comparison ように that is sense (1) of this record.
F-15 follow-up. 学がないように見えるね is the same clause + ように.
B3, the destination the report named. 手に入れられると思いますよ is the potential, and gram:rareru's explanation covers potential (1) and passive (2) in one record.
B3, named destination. 何かすぐ食べられるものある？ is the potential 食べられる.
F5 follow-up. 私は、バスで学校に行く。 is destination に + 行く, which is why it left gram:ni-iku (masu-stem + に + movement verb, purpose only). gram:ni-e is the に/へ destination record.
F5 follow-up. 休暇はどこに行くの？ — destination に.
F5 follow-up. 何駅に行くのですか。 — destination に with a plain noun, the shape gram:ni-iku's nuance rules out.
F-20, the destination the report named. 行かなくてはいけません。 is obligation 〜なくてはいけない, the mirror record of the prohibition point it was sitting on.
B1 follow-up. 工場よりずっといいよ is より + ずっと + adjective — the comparative that gram:gp-95 (durative ずっと ①) excludes. より is the comparison particle the sentence actually turns on.
B1 follow-up. 金は水よりずっと重い。 is the same より comparison.
F-20, the destination the report named. 教育のおかげで私は今日のようになった is のように + なる (simile), not 〜ようになった 'came to be able to'.
F-13, named destination. またいつか風のように走るんだ is the simile ように, a sense gram:gp-128 (purpose / wish) does not cover.

F-19 follow-up. テレビをつけっぱなしにするな！ left gram:ni-suru because XをYにする is not the choice/decision sense. するな is the negative order, which gram:gp-127's own formation states verbatim: 'Para ordem negativa ("não faça!") usa-se a forma de dicionário + な: 行くな'.
X-8 follow-up. それで十分だよ is それ + instrumental で ('com isso já basta'), not the causal connective それで — that is exactly why it left gram:gp-134. Sense (2) of gram:de is 'meio ou instrumento'.
X-14 follow-up. 病気で動かれなくなったのではないかな left gram:dewa-nai-ka because のではないか is conjecture, a different point. 病気で is the causal で, sense (4) of gram:de, whose own example is 病気で休む.
F-18 follow-up. その結果はどうなったのか。 is 結果 + は, not the connective その結果、. なる carries the sentence (どうなった = 'what became of it'), and gram:naru is the change-of-state record.
X-14 follow-up. これは本物のダイヤではないかもしれない is ではない + かもしれない ('pode não ser'), so the point it illustrates is かもしれない, not the rhetorical ではないか.
F5 follow-up. 何か言いたいことがあるの？ left gram:koto-ga-aru as the ordinary noun こと + がある. 言いたい is a clean 〜たい (masu-stem + たい), which is what the sentence teaches.

F-20 follow-up. きっと手紙くださいね。 left gram:kitto because its きっと is the 'without fail' sense that record assigns to 必ず. The ね is a straightforward instance of the confirmation/softening particle. Deliberately NOT filed under gram:o-kudasai, whose whole formation is [substantivo] + を + ください and whose を is dropped here.

B5, the destination the report named (gp-145 / nakucha / gp-52 all exist for it; gp-145 is the one whose form is the full 〜なくちゃいけない). 今日売らなくちゃいけないんだ is obligation, the opposite of the prohibition record it was on.
B5. 本当に行かなくちゃいけないの？ carries 〜なくちゃいけない whole.
B5. それをしなくちゃいけないって分かってるんだよね？ carries 〜なくちゃいけない whole.
B5. そこには俺が行かなくちゃいけないんだ carries 〜なくちゃいけない whole.
F5 follow-up. あなたって、なんてきれいなんでしょう！ left gram:deshou as the exclamatory なんて〜でしょう, which that record does not cover. あなたって is use (2) of gram:tte, the casual topic marker (Substantivo + って = は/というのは).

X-13 follow-up. あしたは、来なくていいよ is 〜なくて(も)いい, dispensation — not a よ- inflection of いい, which is what gram:gp-5 exists to teach. gram:naku-temo-ii is that point; the も is dropped in casual speech, which the sibling record gram:temo-ii-desu's nuance already notes as common.
X-13 follow-up. 何時くらいまでなら電話してもいいですか。 carries 〜てもいいですか whole — asking permission, which is gram:temo-ii-desu's stated use.
X-13 follow-up. 話してもいいですか。 is the permission question.

X-13 follow-up. 遊びに行ってもいい？ is the same permission pattern without です, which the record's own nuance says only lowers the register. Not filed under gram:temo, whose sense is the concessive 'mesmo que'.
X-5 follow-up. 自分でもわかってるくせに left gram:demo as で + も, which that record's nuance excludes. くせに is present whole and is the point the sentence turns on (reproach).
F-13, the destination the report named. 母は私に外出しないようにいった is 〜ように言う, the indirect command, not the purpose or wish sense of gram:gp-128.
F-13, named destination. 父はついてくるように私をせきたてた is the same 〜ように + verb-of-telling reported command.

F-09 follow-up. 見たことはないよ。 is the experiential 〜たことがある in the negative — the very pattern gram:n3-koto-wa-nai's nuance told the learner not to confuse it with. gram:ta-koto-ga-aru's formation states the negative explicitly (〜たことがない / ことがありません); は for が is the ordinary contrastive swap.

F-2. この問題が解けない学生はない is ungrammatical for an animate head (Japanese requires 〜学生はいない), which is why gram:gp-102 released it. Re-tagging it anywhere would put the wrong model back on display under some record. It stays untagged until the sentence itself is rewritten; the skipped report already carries that item.

B7. 内訳はどのようにしましょう？ is どのように ('in what way') + しましょう. gram:mashou is the only record for ましょう and its nuance rules this out in as many words: 'Não é uma pergunta: para perguntar ou oferecer, use ましょうか.' Tagging it there would reproduce the defect this campaign is undoing. There is no どのように record (gram:douyatte is どうやって, a different surface).

B1. 今日はずっと気分がよい is the comparative intensifier ずっと ('muito melhor'), which gram:gp-95's nuance names as a second sense the record does NOT cover — and unlike the other two ずっと carriers it has no より, so gram:yori does not apply either. No record covers comparative ずっと; it needs one, or a rewrite.

F-19. パンダはささをえさにする is the three-place XをYにする ('make X into Y'). gram:ni-suru documents only choice/decision (コーヒーにします) and no other record covers the transformative sense. The remaining candidates (を, は) are bare particles the sentence does not exist to teach.

F-18. その結果はどうなのか。 is 結果 + は + どう + なのか. Its sibling tatoeba-211125 could go to gram:naru because it has なった; this one has no verb at all. Tagging it to gram:wa-topic-marker would be filing a sentence under a particle it merely contains.

F5. さあ、ピザがいる人ー！ uses 要る ('to need'), not the existence verb, and no record covers 要る (gram:ga-hitsuyou is 〜が必要, a different surface). ピザがいる人 is also a dictionary-form relative clause, which gram:gp-36 restricts to た / ている.

X-5. 万人の友は誰の友でもない is the copula で + も + ない. gram:demo's nuance names this exact combination as something to distinguish from the conjunction でも, and gram:mo's nuance says its も SUBSTITUTES は/が, which this one does not — it rides on で. No record covers 〜でもない.

B2. 夜が明けようとしている is 〜ようとしている ('on the point of'). The registry has gram:you-to-omou (ようと思う) and gram:n3-you-to-shinai (ようとしない) but no plain ようとする. Tagging the ている half to gram:te-iru would present 明けようとしている as an ordinary progressive, which is the misread the record should prevent.
F-13. 面白いように思います is 〜ように思う ('it seems to me'), a pattern gram:you-ni-you-na does not list (it covers comparison and purpose) and gram:to-omou does not match (と思う, not ように思う). No record covers it.

B3. 父上、何をしておられるのか is honorific おられる (おる + れる). gram:rareru covers potential and passive only, and the registry's honorific records are gram:irassharu (いらっしゃる), gram:nasaru (なさる) and gram:o-ni-naru (お〜になる) — none of which appears here. No record covers 〜ておられる.

grammar_identity_merges.md §2.2. The record teaches the noun-modifying (relative) clause, but forms[] listed the bare morphemes た and ている, so a forms table, a flashcard front or an exercise stem renders 'the form' as a past-tense ending — which is gram:te-iru's territory, not this record's, and says nothing about the noun that must follow. [A] is the registry's own slot notation (gram:no-naka-de-a-ga-ichiban writes の中で[A]が一番) and scripts/export/pattern_forms.py treats a bracketed slot as a placeholder, so the literal pieces stay た and ている: the speaking-path check matches exactly what it matched before, in all nine units that name gram:gp-36. No ～ is used. structure_pattern (Verb［た・ている］+ Noun) is deliberate metalanguage and is left alone — grammar_accuracy_2.md L-5 confirms it as clean.

old.た: forma passada que modifica substantivo (que fez)
old.ている: forma em andamento/estado que modifica substantivo (que está fazendo)

new.た[A]: verbo na forma た modificando o substantivo [A] que vem depois (que fez)
new.ている[A]: verbo na forma ている modificando o substantivo [A] que vem depois (que está fazendo / que está)

why: form_meanings is keyed by the form string, so it has to be re-keyed with forms_json or the gloss column goes blank. The wording now names the slot the form points at.

old.た: past form modifying a noun (that did)
old.ている: progressive/stative form modifying a noun (that is doing)

new.た[A]: た-form verb modifying the noun [A] that follows (that did)
new.ている[A]: ている-form verb modifying the noun [A] that follows (that is doing / that is)

why: en counterpart of the re-key above.

D4. The pattern itself lost its medial placeholder, so the record claims the form is ×すこしもない — a string no sentence contains, and one that hides the whole point (すこしも opens, the predicate must close NEGATIVE). Contrast gram:n3-metta-ni-nai, which correctly keeps めったに～ない. Tilde is U+FF5E, the character this record's siblings use.

D4 says in as many words that fixing structure_pattern alone would leave the two disagreeing, which is worse than the current consistent-but-wrong state. This is the one place in this pass where a form carries ～: it is MEDIAL (the whole defect is that the medial slot was stripped), every other n3 form is written the same way, and under scripts/export/pattern_forms.py the new value is strictly MORE permissive than the old one — 'すこしも' then 'ない' in order, instead of the contiguous non-word — so no speaking-path check that passes today can start failing.

D7. The leading ～ says something attaches in front, which is exactly what the record rules out: its formation puts そのために between two independent sentences and its steps_unavailable calls it an invariable sentence-initial connective. That leading tilde is also the only thing distinguishing it from the 〜ために that DOES attach to a verb — a contrast the record itself draws.

Same defect in the paired column. The campaign already did exactly this for gram:n3-tsumari (～つまり → つまり) on the same reasoning. Matching is unchanged: pattern_forms strips a leading placeholder anyway, so the literal piece was そのために before and after.

D4 names refs.label_en as carrying the same placeholder-stripping damage as forms[]: ×てすみ is a truncated non-word. Restored to the record's pattern with the harmless leading ～ dropped (D4: 'Stripping a leading ～ is harmless'). Same shape as the two label_en repairs apply_phase7_content_repairs.py already landed (gp-83 → まい, gp-152 → てほしい).
D4. ×はの一つ is the medial placeholder collapsed and the closing だ dropped. The MEDIAL slot is restored, because without it the value reads as a non-word; the leading one stays off, per D4's own rule.

E1. replace-ending appears 21 times corpus-wide; 18 encode the token as from→to (て→ちゃ, い→さ, い→そう, て→とく...) and only sugiru / gp-26 / te-de encode the replacement alone. One executor cannot read both grammars: reading すぎる as from→to is meaningless, and reading て→ちゃ as 'replace the final kana with this' mis-executes it. い→すぎる keeps the single-kana left side that apply_grammar_formation_repairs.py requires (an arrow is a SUFFIX rewrite) and produces 高すぎる exactly as before.
E1, second of the three outliers. い→くて executes on 高い as 高くて, unchanged.
E1, third outlier. Same edit as gp-26; the な-adjective and noun variants are appends and are untouched.

variants.example: 勉強しているおかげで

why: E2. The to-dictionary variant emitted 勉強するおかげで, which no speaker produces: おかげで attributes a result to a completed cause or a standing state. Replaced with the standing-state branch the report itself proposed (to-te-form > append いるおかげで → 勉強しているおかげで) rather than dropped, so the record keeps a non-past variant. The prose already licenses it — 'verbo na forma comum (casual) + おかげで' — and 勉強している is a forma comum. The past branch is untouched and is still the record's own worked example.

F-32. steps_unavailable said 'NOT AUTHORED: … this one fell outside every batch range', i.e. a coverage gap, not a judgement that the rule cannot be stated. The rule is stateable: to-nai-stem is the な-inclusive stem in this corpus (gram:gp-148 runs to-nai-stem > append くてすみません for 電話しなくてすみません, gram:sou-ni-sou-na to-nai-stem > append さそうな for 降らなさそうな), so 飲む → 飲まな, then the single-kana arrow な→ずに gives 飲まずに. Executed on the standard test set: 書く→書かずに, 食べる→食べずに, くる→こずに. One residual: する yields ×しずに, and the record's own formation already states the exception in both locales ('する não vira *しずに, e sim せずに'); it cannot be encoded, because the base enum has no suru value and a する→せずに arrow would be the multi-kana suffix rewrite apply_grammar_formation_repairs.py refuses. Same tolerance the merged gram:sugiru rule carries for いい→よすぎる.

old: NOT AUTHORED: the roadmap-E campaign covered 495 of the 496 registered points (33 batches of 15) and this one fell outside every batch range. This is a coverage gap, not a judgement that the record is too vague to state.

old: Two-slot frame whose closing half is an open clause, not a fixed token. The record specifies the opening half exactly (noun / number / plain verb + くらい + は) but then says the frame closes with a negative clause OR with 〜ないと, i.e. free material no append token can stand for. A sequence ending at くらいは would emit 週に一度くらいは and silently drop the obligatory negative that carries this point's whole meaning, teaching plain くらい + は instead. Note also that this record's structure_pattern and forms[0].form are corrupted with an editing instruction in place of the pattern (failure mode F6); only the formation prose was usable.

X-9. Three of five carriers (わざわざ電話をかけてくださらなくてけっこうです / お水だけでけっこうです / いいえ、けっこうです。) are the polite けっこうです, which appears in the record's nuance as an aside but had no entry in forms, so the compact forms table claims the record covers only the degree adverb. The report offered either a second forms entry or moving the three sentences off; the second option would discard three correct human-written sentences and leave the record with two, so the entry is added. No ～: けっこうです is a surface string that occurs verbatim in all three.

new.けっこうです: está bom assim / não, obrigado (recusa educada ou 'já basta')

why: X-9 warns that adding the form without its gloss recreates defect S-2 (a forms entry with an empty meaning), and the two columns are keyed by the same string, so they are written together. The gloss covers both readings the three carriers show: acceptance ('お水だけでけっこうです') and refusal ('いいえ、けっこうです').

new.けっこうです: that's fine as it is / no, thank you (polite refusal or 'that's enough')

why: en counterpart of the gloss above.
